items.name: Houston Rx LLC
items.facts: Class II recall by Houston Rx LLC. Product: Sermorelin, 1 mg/mL, 10 ml vial, Sterile injectable solution, RX Only, Houston RX LLC, 15430 Vantage Parkway E STE 220, Houston, TX 77032.. Reason: Lack of process control. Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: Houston Rx LLC has initiated a Class II recall for Sermorelin injectable solution due to a lack of process control.

items.name: Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc
items.facts: Class II recall by Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. Product: Metoclopramide Tablets, USP, 5 mg, [100 or 500] Tablets per bottle, Rx Only, Manufactured for: Teva Pharmaceuticals, Parsippany, NJ 07054.  NDC 100 Tablets: 0093-2204-01; NDC 500 Tablets: 0093-2204-05. Reason: Presence of Foreign Tablets/Capsules. Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. is recalling Metoclopramide Tablets due to the presence of foreign tablets or capsules.

items.name: American Health Packaging
items.facts: Class II recall by American Health Packaging. Product: Metoclopramide Tablets, USP, 5 mg, 100 Tablets (10 x 10), Rx Only, Distributed by: American Health Packaging, Columbus, Ohio 43217.  NDC Carton: 60687-620-01; NDC Unit Dose: 60687-620-11. Reason: Presence of Foreign Tablets/Capsules. Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: American Health Packaging recalled Metoclopramide Tablets following reports of foreign tablets or capsules found in the product.

items.name: Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc
items.facts: Class II recall by Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc. Product: Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate for Injection, USP 100 mg/vial, 1 Vial, Rx Only, Manufactured by: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd., Vadodara - 391510 India, Distributed by: Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc., Pennington, NJ 08534, NDC 70710-1907-1.. Reason: Failed Impurities/Degradation Specifications.. Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc. is recalling Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate for Injection because it failed impurities and degradation specifications.

items.name: Houston Rx LLC
items.facts: Class II recall by Houston Rx LLC. Product: Tirzepatide/Niacinamide 2mL vial (40 MG per Vial) Inj 20mg/2mg/mL, RX Only, Houston RX LLC, 15430 Vantage Parkway E STE 220, Houston, TX 77032.. Reason: Lack of assurance of sterility.. Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: Houston Rx LLC recalled Tirzepatide/Niacinamide injection due to a lack of assurance of sterility.

why_it_matters.text: These ongoing recalls highlight critical quality and safety concerns across multiple manufacturers, including foreign tablet contamination, sterility assurance failures, lack of process control, and out-of-specification impurities [D-0041-2027, D-0038-2027, D-0042-2027, D-0039-2027, D-0040-2027].
